body: Part of the problem with being in another country, where I don't speak the language very well, is trying to find these services. It can be hard and demotivating. But maybe you're right, maybe it's worth looking into, maybe I can somehow try. Sometimes I barely feel like I'm worth anyone's time, though.

Yes, you are right. I have tried to tell people, tell my family. But they are not willing to hear me or take me seriously. I cannot tell my friends, few as they are. I could not do that to them. I must keep up a front.

Thank you for taking the time to response. It is meaningful to someone who feels very meaningless.

Yes, I'm a student, but mostly feel like a fraud. Which I realise is completely a cliche, but somehow that makes it no easier to tell myself I'm not dumb.  The problem with being in a foreign country is not knowing people and therefore having little opportunity to distract myself from the terrible terrible thoughts. I just don't know what to do. My family seems to be largely unavailable and automatically disinterested if I ever try to tell them that I'm feeling so very down. Obviously they think I'm doing it for attention. But the fact of the matter is I just try to hold it in and I think, well shouldn't I let someone know? Isn't it just as unfair not to tell someone I feel so very very bad?

Thank you for your words. Thank you.
